artifact_tests.scope: Newline records only; a bounded 8 MiB-character buffer is required. No custom separators.
Empty lines are unnumbered. Logical-page escape sequences are treated as literal text.
One full-field sort key; numeric mode requires finite decimal/scientific values. No locale, random or human-size sorting. Bounded 8 MiB-character row buffer.
As upstream, strips surrounding row whitespace before sorting fields.
Whole line or one selected field; stable representative, bounded 8 MiB-character buffer. Header lines pass unchanged.
Only consecutive duplicates are grouped; no arbitrary field skipping or blank-delimited grouping.
Literal nonempty separator; at most 10000 output rows and 16 MiB estimated characters per input row. Fixes upstream last-column newline handling.
Literal matching only: no regular expressions, shell commands, sed programs or replacement backreferences. Case-insensitive matching is locale-independent. Missing selected columns fail.
Literal matching only: no regular expressions, shell commands, sed programs or replacement backreferences. Case-insensitive matching is locale-independent. Missing selected columns fail.
Literal matching only: no regular expressions, shell commands, sed programs or replacement backreferences. Case-insensitive matching is locale-independent. Missing selected columns fail.
Literal text search; no regex, context-line expansion or HTML output.
Unique header names and requested names are required. Ragged rows and unknown headers fail.
Existing data lines are normalized to LF; this avoids concatenating a footer onto an unterminated final row.
One explicit repetition group, bounded 16 MiB output expansion; input is drained, not used to infer repetitions.
Tab-delimited UTF-8; optional leading-character stripping on first header field. Retains source column order. Unknown requested headers fail.
Zero sorts every column; otherwise a one-based column stays first. Headers must be unique.
The input label is explicit configuration; no local path or filename is required.
Explicit character widths only; no automatic boundary detection, FORTRAN descriptors, reports or encoding conversion. Long rows or unpadded short rows fail.
A/C/G/T primer followed only by 0..3; wrapped sequence lines accepted. Buffers at most one 8 MiB-character sequence.

Select mate 1 or 2; validates four-line FASTQ, optional matching + title, equal sequence/quality lengths and even sequence length. No silent truncation. An empty + title remains empty so emitted FASTQ remains valid.

One-based pileup to zero-based half-open intervals. Configurable columns cover six-column, legacy ten-column and custom rows. Active interval limited to 8 MiB bases; blank lines are skipped rather than terminating all input.
Rows with more than two alleles are skipped. Homozygous second allele is N or the configured reference column; extra input columns are retained.

Zero selects all samples; otherwise use a one-based VCF column >=10. Only single-base A/C/G/T SNPs with PASS or missing FILTER are converted. GT position, haploidy, phased calls and all allele indices are handled; missing alleles ignored.
FASTA input/output only; DNA or RNA IUPAC symbols, case preserved, invalid characters rejected. One sequence buffered up to 8 MiB characters.

Standard code table 1, FASTA only. Ambiguous complete codons emit X; terminal partial codons fail. CDS requires ATG start, terminal stop and no internal stop; final stop omitted. Alternate genetic codes are not advertised.
Input lengths must be multiples of three. Only A/C/G/T codons are accepted; output is deterministic lexicographic codon/count TSV, including zero counts.
FASTA input. GC denominator includes ambiguous symbols; zero-length records use GC fraction zero. Output CG% is the upstream fraction, not a percentage.

Uses reverse complement for reverse-strand search, correcting the upstream complement-only bug. Overlapping hits are consistently included. Maximum one million candidate comparisons per record times pattern length is bounded to 64 million.

Statistics TSV output only, no separate gap BED. N-runs split contigs; internal N-runs count as gaps. Uses standard N50 threshold >= half, correcting upstream strict-greater edge. At most 100000 sequences/contigs and one 8 MiB-character record.

Input has an odd number of tab-separated windows with literal indel in the middle. Motifs are literal case-insensitive DNA strings configured by name=sequence or sequence. Output is row-major then motif order to stream without replaying input; upstream uses motif-major order. Regex motifs are not supported.
FASTA text; sequence IDs must be unique. Colors are indexed from zero. No image rendering.
Unquoted tab-separated ID and positive length; unlike upstream, malformed rows fail explicitly.
BED3 or BED6+; zero-based half-open coordinates. Extra BED fields are ignored.
BED6+ required; zero-based half-open coordinates. Extra BED fields are ignored.

Flat GFF3 only: Parent hierarchies are rejected rather than flattened. Input chromosome order is preserved; features sort by start. One-based inclusive GFF becomes zero-based half-open. Up to 100000 rows and 8 MiB characters.
Flat GFF3 only; Parent hierarchies rejected. Features without the selected attribute are skipped. Coordinates converted to zero-based half-open; at most 100000 rows and 8 MiB characters.
NCBI translation table 1 only; uppercase normalization and U-to-T conversion. All terminal stops removed; partial terminal codons retained. At most 8 MiB characters per sequence.
Text interval mode only. Zero-based inclusive input becomes half-open BED; global wm_N labels begin at zero.
Counts syntactically valid nine-column GFF records, not logical exon groups. Malformed rows fail rather than silently skipping. FASTA sections are rejected.
Nine-column GFF; uses a common chromosome-length parameter rather than a chromosome-length file. Midpoint uses floor division; comments skipped, malformed rows rejected.
Stable start sort, no genome-order file. Buffer at most 100000 rows or 8 MiB characters. BED input is zero-based half-open with positive interval length. Comments are skipped; invalid records fail.

Sorted input required, output BED3. Distance zero merges book-ended intervals; no strand or extra-column aggregations. BED input is zero-based half-open with positive interval length. Comments are skipped; invalid records fail.

Sorted input required, global IDs start at one; unstranded mode, original columns retained. BED input is zero-based half-open with positive interval length. Comments are skipped; invalid records fail.

Sorted input required. First interval per chromosome uses dot; any overlap uses -1; touching uses zero. BED input is zero-based half-open with positive interval length. Comments are skipped; invalid records fail.

Integer base distances and optional strand awareness. Chromosome lengths are explicit parameters, not a local file. BED input is zero-based half-open with positive interval length. Comments are skipped; invalid records fail.

Left flank then right flank; zero-length flanks omitted. Integer distances, optional strand awareness, explicit chromosome lengths. BED input is zero-based half-open with positive interval length. Comments are skipped; invalid records fail.

Sorts and unions input, reports all configured chromosomes in parameter order. Buffer at most 100000 rows or 8 MiB characters. BED input is zero-based half-open with positive interval length. Comments are skipped; invalid records fail.

BED interval coverage, no BAM/CIGAR or split blocks. Emits bedGraph rather than histograms. At most 100000 rows or 8 MiB characters, plus two events per interval. BED input is zero-based half-open with positive interval length. Comments are skipped; invalid records fail.

Coordinates are taken from configured columns on the same row; chromosome identity is the caller responsibility, matching upstream. Positive overlap, zero touching, negative separation. Comments are skipped; invalid records fail.

UTF-8 TSV, no BED coordinate interpretation. Columns must be unique and increasing; no Cartesian product. At most 10000 expansions and 16 MiB estimated output per row. Comments are skipped; invalid records fail.

One grouping key and one value column. Input must group equal keys consecutively; no automatic global sorting. Text aggregation bounded to 8 MiB characters and 100000 values per group. Comments are skipped; invalid records fail.

Title tabs become spaces; short descriptions are padded to exactly the requested width. Four-line nucleotide FASTQ only, at most 1 MiB characters per line; sequence and quality lengths and optional + titles must match. No color-space or compression inside the operator.

Malformed rows fail instead of being silently skipped. Output Phred+33. Four-line nucleotide FASTQ only, at most 1 MiB characters per line; sequence and quality lengths and optional + titles must match. No color-space or compression inside the operator.

ASCII Phred+33. Quality strings are retained unchanged. Four-line nucleotide FASTQ only, at most 1 MiB characters per line; sequence and quality lengths and optional + titles must match. No color-space or compression inside the operator.

ASCII Phred+33, whole-read ranges only; no generated Python predicates or per-window expressions. Four-line nucleotide FASTQ only, at most 1 MiB characters per line; sequence and quality lengths and optional + titles must match. No color-space or compression inside the operator.

Adjacent /1 and /2 mates with equal base IDs, either order; no identifier-indexed second input. Unmatched or misordered pairs fail. Does not reverse-complement mate 2. Four-line nucleotide FASTQ only, at most 1 MiB characters per line; sequence and quality lengths and optional + titles must match. No color-space or compression inside the operator.

Slash /1 and /2 IDs only. Matches mates regardless of adjacency using a bounded 8 MiB-character / 100000-read buffer. Duplicate full IDs fail; original first-pair encounter order is preserved. Four-line nucleotide FASTQ only, at most 1 MiB characters per line; sequence and quality lengths and optional + titles must match. No color-space or compression inside the operator.

Sanger Phred+33, Illumina Phred+64, Solexa log-odds+64; scores are rounded and clipped to the output convention. Existing titles must agree; no automatic repair. Four-line nucleotide FASTQ only, at most 1 MiB characters per line; sequence and quality lengths and optional + titles must match. No color-space or compression inside the operator.

Normalized TSV columns documented by the header, not the upstream report layout. Linear-interpolated quartiles, ASCII Phred+33, at most 10000 positions; fixed 94-bin quality histograms avoid retaining reads. Four-line nucleotide FASTQ only, at most 1 MiB characters per line; sequence and quality lengths and optional + titles must match. No color-space or compression inside the operator.

Full sequences only; no BED subset. CpG counts both contributing positions, including C/Y and G/R ambiguity contexts. FASTA text only unless explicitly stated; one sequence is limited to 8 MiB characters. Output is LF-normalized and unwrapped.

Only two-base ambiguity symbols qualify; original character case is retained. FASTA text only unless explicitly stated; one sequence is limited to 8 MiB characters. Output is LF-normalized and unwrapped.

Scored forward/backward N-tract extension; no gap-only channel. Output names use one-based inclusive segment endpoints. Leading gaps are removed consistently. FASTA text only unless explicitly stated; one sequence is limited to 8 MiB characters. Output is LF-normalized and unwrapped.

Only two-allele symbols are resolved; other ambiguity symbols remain. JVM RNG intentionally differs from seqtk drand48; case preserved. FASTA text only unless explicitly stated; one sequence is limited to 8 MiB characters. Output is LF-normalized and unwrapped.

Single-pass count-based sampling; no fraction or two-pass mode. JVM RNG differs from seqtk. Reservoir output order; total retained characters limited to 8 MiB. FASTA text only unless explicitly stated; one sequence is limited to 8 MiB characters. Output is LF-normalized and unwrapped.

Coordinates are zero-based half-open, names contain one-based inclusive endpoints. Out-of-bounds matching regions fail; absent sequence IDs produce no output. Regions are emitted in input sequence order then configuration order. FASTA text only unless explicitly stated; one sequence is limited to 8 MiB characters. Output is LF-normalized and unwrapped.

Subset of seqtk seq: case normalization, comments, minimum length, ambiguous-sequence removal and wrapping. No region masks, quality transformation or random subsampling. FASTA text only unless explicitly stated; one sequence is limited to 8 MiB characters. Output is LF-normalized and unwrapped.

seqtk sliding-window labeling: later rows start at the previous emission boundary, even for overlapping windows. Two-base IUPAC codes are heterozygous; three/four-base codes uncallable. No division by zero; at most 64 million window-base visits. FASTA text only unless explicitly stated; one sequence is limited to 8 MiB characters. Output is LF-normalized and unwrapped.

Terminal motif rotations with seqtk 5-prime/3-prime scoring and reverse-complement search. Motif length 1..31; BED4 contains sequence length, no profile channel. FASTA text only unless explicitly stated; one sequence is limited to 8 MiB characters. Output is LF-normalized and unwrapped.

Four-line nucleotide FASTQ with Phred+33. Maximum scoring segment and best-quality fixed-window fallback; fully trimmed records are omitted rather than empty FASTQ. FASTA text only unless explicitly stated; one sequence is limited to 8 MiB characters. Output is LF-normalized and unwrapped.

Four-line FASTQ, Phred+33. Adjacent equal IDs or equal IDs after removing /digit form pairs, matching seqtk. A displaced or unmatched record is discarded; no global mate search. FASTA text only unless explicitly stated; one sequence is limited to 8 MiB characters. Output is LF-normalized and unwrapped.

Four-line FASTQ, Phred+33, at most 10000 positions. seqtk probability floor for Q0..Q3; exact -10log10(mean error), without the upstream small smoothing term; normalized table omits the summary preamble and q=0 histogram mode. FASTA text only unless explicitly stated; one sequence is limited to 8 MiB characters. Output is LF-normalized and unwrapped.
Strict rectangular, unquoted UTF-8 TSV; empty cells preserved. At most 8 MiB characters and 100000 rows; no split files.
Unquoted UTF-8 TSV; rows may have different widths. Preserves empty fields, without reversing row order.
One global column, no grouping. Reports count/sum/min/max/mean/median/population and sample SD in a normalized table, not the datamash CLI layout. Finite magnitudes <=1e100, at most 100000 values.

Matches upstream header-inclusive numeric/string voting, with known numeric headers 1000g2012apr_all and esp6500si_all. Numeric ties choose numeric. Rectangular TSV buffered up to 8 MiB characters and 100000 rows.
Nine-column GFF; one-based inclusive to zero-based half-open. Corrects upstream end-minus-one error; preserves the inclusive end as the BED exclusive endpoint. Malformed records fail.
FASTA nucleotide input, bedGraph text rather than upstream BigWig. (G-C)/(G+C), zero when denominator is zero. Final interval clipped to sequence length; one sequence up to 8 MiB characters.

Strict finite numeric rows, no NA imputation or Kendall method. Rectangular output, six decimals. Constant columns reject undefined correlation. At most 100000 rows, 16 columns and 8 MiB-character buffer.
BED9+ with validated 0..255 RGB triplets. Uses inline RGB values so the bytes result is self-contained, unlike upstream separate stderr color definitions. Malformed rows fail.

First TSV row contains criterion names only; following rows contain an element ID then numeric values. Only positive values contribute. Unknown members fail; each member belongs to exactly one category; at most 128 criteria and 128 configured categories.
Strict uncompressed UTF-8 VCF text with one #CHROM header; no BCF, indexing or expression evaluation. Up to 1024 samples; malformed records fail.

GT-only dosage; count all nonreference alleles; any missing allele produces missing dosage. Normalized TSV, no PL/GL likelihoods. Strict uncompressed UTF-8 VCF text with one #CHROM header; no BCF, indexing or expression evaluation. Up to 1024 samples; malformed records fail.

Replaces each missing GT allele with zero, retaining phase separators and other FORMAT values; INFO tags remain unchanged. Strict uncompressed UTF-8 VCF text with one #CHROM header; no BCF, indexing or expression evaluation. Up to 1024 samples; malformed records fail.

Counts called alleles including partial calls, supports multiallelic and haploid/polyploid GT; replaces existing AN/AC and their declarations. Strict uncompressed UTF-8 VCF text with one #CHROM header; no BCF, indexing or expression evaluation. Up to 1024 samples; malformed records fail.

A multiallelic site can contribute to multiple classes; symbolic alleles count as other. Normalized TSV. Strict uncompressed UTF-8 VCF text with one #CHROM header; no BCF, indexing or expression evaluation. Up to 1024 samples; malformed records fail.

Does not recalculate INFO allele counts. Unknown or duplicate names reject input. Strict uncompressed UTF-8 VCF text with one #CHROM header; no BCF, indexing or expression evaluation. Up to 1024 samples; malformed records fail.

Only sample names are changed; chromosome metadata and sample values remain intact. Strict uncompressed UTF-8 VCF text with one #CHROM header; no BCF, indexing or expression evaluation. Up to 1024 samples; malformed records fail.

Only INFO tags are removed, not FORMAT or arbitrary columns. Strict uncompressed UTF-8 VCF text with one #CHROM header; no BCF, indexing or expression evaluation. Up to 1024 samples; malformed records fail.

Adds LowQual to failing records; existing non-PASS filters retained. No arbitrary expressions. Strict uncompressed UTF-8 VCF text with one #CHROM header; no BCF, indexing or expression evaluation. Up to 1024 samples; malformed records fail.

Resets all GT alleles to missing; preserves phase, ploidy and other FORMAT values. Does not recalculate INFO tags. Strict uncompressed UTF-8 VCF text with one #CHROM header; no BCF, indexing or expression evaluation. Up to 1024 samples; malformed records fail.

Constant ploidy for all samples and contigs; no sex maps or likelihood remapping. Other FORMAT fields unchanged. Strict uncompressed UTF-8 VCF text with one #CHROM header; no BCF, indexing or expression evaluation. Up to 1024 samples; malformed records fail.

Fixed explicit CHROM/POS/REF/ALT/SAMPLE/GT schema; all samples, no format-string language. Strict uncompressed UTF-8 VCF text with one #CHROM header; no BCF, indexing or expression evaluation. Up to 1024 samples; malformed records fail.

Normalized TSV counts; no percentage formatting. Paired/read1/read2/proper-pair/singleton categories count primary alignments, matching samtools; mapped and duplicate totals include all records. UTF-8 SAM text only, no BAM/CRAM or indexed random access. Requires @SQ for mapped reads; validates flags, coordinates, CIGAR, sequence and quality. At most 100000 reference sequences.

Streaming full-scan equivalent of idxstats; counts records by mapped flag, retaining header reference order. UTF-8 SAM text only, no BAM/CRAM or indexed random access. Requires @SQ for mapped reads; validates flags, coordinates, CIGAR, sequence and quality. At most 100000 reference sequences.

Counts M/=/X only, excluding D/N and flags 0x704. Overlapping mates counted independently, no quality threshold; sparse nonzero positions. Buffers at most 1000000 alignment blocks and 8 MiB input characters. UTF-8 SAM text only, no BAM/CRAM or indexed random access. Requires @SQ for mapped reads; validates flags, coordinates, CIGAR, sequence and quality. At most 100000 reference sequences.

M/=/X blocks, flags 0x704 excluded; overlapping mates counted independently. Includes every header reference. Buffers at most 1000000 blocks and 8 MiB input characters. UTF-8 SAM text only, no BAM/CRAM or indexed random access. Requires @SQ for mapped reads; validates flags, coordinates, CIGAR, sequence and quality. At most 100000 reference sequences.

Primary records only, excluding secondary/supplementary. Normalized summary subset, not samtools stats report. Aligned bases count M/=/X. UTF-8 SAM text only, no BAM/CRAM or indexed random access. Requires @SQ for mapped reads; validates flags, coordinates, CIGAR, sequence and quality. At most 100000 reference sequences.

Stable bounded in-memory sort, at most 100000 records and 8 MiB characters; query names use lexical, not natural numeric, order. UTF-8 SAM text only, no BAM/CRAM or indexed random access. Requires @SQ for mapped reads; validates flags, coordinates, CIGAR, sequence and quality. At most 100000 reference sequences.

First-seen query-name order; within-name input order. Buffers at most 100000 records and 8 MiB characters; no randomized ordering. UTF-8 SAM text only, no BAM/CRAM or indexed random access. Requires @SQ for mapped reads; validates flags, coordinates, CIGAR, sequence and quality. At most 100000 reference sequences.

Primary records with sequences; reverse-complement reverse-strand SEQ and reverse QUAL. Does not pair or deduplicate names; absent QUAL becomes configurable Phred quality. UTF-8 SAM text only, no BAM/CRAM or indexed random access. Requires @SQ for mapped reads; validates flags, coordinates, CIGAR, sequence and quality. At most 100000 reference sequences.

Replaces header text only; requires an identical ordered @SQ dictionary, so alignments remain valid. UTF-8 SAM text only, no BAM/CRAM or indexed random access. Requires @SQ for mapped reads; validates flags, coordinates, CIGAR, sequence and quality. At most 100000 reference sequences.

M/=/X/D/I CIGAR only; N skips rejected. Calculates substitutions/deletions in MD and edit distance NM; no BAQ or reference downloads. Missing reference or unavailable SEQ fails. UTF-8 SAM text only, no BAM/CRAM or indexed random access. Requires @SQ for mapped reads; validates flags, coordinates, CIGAR, sequence and quality. At most 100000 reference sequences.
